fact_basis.fact: 2026 IRA contribution limit is $7,500, up from $7,000 for 2025
Page text: "The IRS caps the contribution at the child's earnings or the annual IRA limit ($7,000 in 2025), whichever is lower."
fact_basis.source: this page, section "The earned-income gate decides eligibility"

actions.q: Can a custodial Roth IRA be used to pay for college?

fact_basis.fact: Roth IRA contributions can be withdrawn anytime tax- and penalty-free (page table, FAQ text and "Different tax breaks" section)
fact_basis.source: this page, "Different tax breaks for different goals"

fact_basis.fact: Withdrawals from an IRA (traditional or Roth) before 59½ for qualified higher education expenses (tuition, fees, books, supplies, equipment) of the owner, spouse, child or grandchild are not subject to the 10% additional tax; income tax may still be owed on the taxable part
fact_basis.source: https://www.irs.gov/publications/p970 (Education Exception to Additional Tax on Early IRA Distributions)
